categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the production and sales of Maotai liquor and related series of alcoholic beverages. It also involves the production and sales of beverages, food, packaging materials, anti-counterfeiting technology development, information industry products, hotel management, accommodation, catering, entertainment, vehicle transportation, and telecommunications services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses traditional solid-state fermentation and unique brewing techniques inherited over a thousand years, including a natural fermentation process with a unique microbial community. The production process includes saccharification, fermentation, storage, blending, and packaging, emphasizing quality control and ecological protection. It also integrates modern digital marketing and supply chain management technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves primarily domestic and international consumers of high-end alcoholic beverages, with a marketing network covering China and 64 countries and regions across five continents. Key customers include distributors, supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and direct consumers through digital platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in Maotai Town, Renhuai City, Guizhou Province, China, with sales covering domestic markets and international markets spanning 64 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on raw material procurement, production, and sales of finished liquor products. It manages upstream raw material sourcing through partnerships with local governments, suppliers, cooperatives, and farmers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include high-quality development guided by traditional craftsmanship and modern innovation, deepening ESG integration, enhancing brand influence, expanding digital marketing platforms, and advancing production capacity through major technical renovation projects. R&D focuses on digital marketing systems, industrial internet applications, blockchain for supply chain traceability, and machine learning for brewing technology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of Maotai liquor and related series. Sales channels include direct sales via self-operated and digital platforms and wholesale through distributors, supermarkets, and e-commerce. The company also earns income from licensing, investments, and financial services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position as the top global brand in the liquor industry, with a unique high-end product portfolio including billion-yuan single products. It is recognized as the world's most valuable liquor brand and maintains a dominant market share in premium Chinese baijiu, facing competition primarily from other domestic and international liquor producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 147.7 billion, a 19% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 74.7 billion, growing 19.16%. The company’s market capitalization remains above RMB 2 trillion, with consistent double-digit growth and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes unparalleled product quality rooted in unique geographic origin protection, traditional brewing craftsmanship, and long-term aging of base liquor. It leverages a strong brand heritage, cultural influence, and ecological sustainability to differentiate its products. The integration of traditional art and modern science creates a distinctive flavor profile and premium consumer experience.
